content_sections.heading: GJUST Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GJUST Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download GJUST Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: GJUST Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 33 vacancies are available - 3 for Allied Health Sciences (BMRIT programme), 3 for Applied Psychology, 6 for Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, 4 for Commerce, 10 for Computer Science & Engineering, 1 for Food Technology, 3 for Geography, 1 for Library and Information Science, 1 for Physiotherapy (Sports specialisation) and 1 for Yoga Science.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GJUST Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Part Time Teacher posts at GJUST?
faq.answer: There are a total of 33 vacancies announced for the Part Time Teacher positions at Guru Jambheshwar University of Science & Technology (GJUST) for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Part Time Teacher posts ranges from Rs. 1500 to Rs. 50000 per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Part Time Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications are as per UGC/AICTE/RCI/NCAHP for Assistant Professor, with specific requirements varying by department.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for GJUST Part Time Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on different dates: 12th September 2026, 14th September 2026, and 15th September 2026, depending on the department.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at Guru Jambheshwar University of Science & Technology, Hisar, Haryana. Specific venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is there a last date to apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no online application process. This is a walk-in recruitment, so candidates need to attend the interview directly on the scheduled dates.
